attempts.exactPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Create one premium realistic painterly raster character concept for the manifest-bound target "affinity-workflow-v1-elemental-fire".

Subject and threat:
- Species: elemental.
- Threat presentation tier: elite; reference Grade 4; canonical Grade not assigned.
- Battlefield duty: bound-frontline-vanguard.
- Construction mode: substance-bodied.
- Fixed chassis: bound-vanguard-elemental.

Identity invariants:
- the same Bound Vanguard Elemental chassis in every affinity
- concentrated hexagonal core at the sternum
- pale arcane binding lattice that remains locally readable
- broad wedge forearms and a low stable torso

Anatomy invariants:
- two arms and two legs
- no head or neck
- five major body masses: torso, two wedge arms, and two planted legs
- affinity substance changes while chassis proportions remain fixed

Affinity: fire.
Affinity expression: heat-blackened surfaces, internal ember seams, controlled combustion, smoke, and heat distortion
Counterplay cue: The internal core or heat sink becomes exposed between combustion cycles.
Altered dimensions: material; motion; attack-telegraph; environmental-wake.
Permitted transformations: material; motion; attack telegraph; environmental wake.
Prohibited traits: extra limbs; humanoid face; floating amorphous blob; changed chassis proportions; a uniform orange full-body glow that destroys material and anatomy detail.

Presentation:
- Style: Pack 2 premium realistic painterly medieval dark fantasy with coherent materials, controlled linework, grounded anatomy, and restrained local magical emission.
- Medium: premium realistic painterly raster character concept.
- Background: neutral cracked-stone floor against a charcoal-to-midnight backdrop.
- Lighting: controlled neutral key with restrained local affinity emission and readable materials.
- Composition: Exactly one subject; entire creature and every extremity visible, centered with finished detail across the canvas.
- Canvas: 1536 x 1024 image/png with at least 8 percent safe margin around the entire silhouette and all extremities.
- Framing lock: fit every hard extent—including weapon tip, standard, horns, tail, and effect wake—inside the central 84 percent of both canvas dimensions; leave a clearly empty border on all four sides.

Reference routing, in supplied order:
1. assets/enemies/review/pack-2/benchmarks/stone-breaker-anchor-v1.png — Individual bipedal elemental framing, grounded weight, wedge forearms, and readable core only; preserve the new Bound Vanguard proportions rather than copying the Stone Breaker identity.
2. assets/enemies/review/pack-2/elementals-v1.png — Elemental material behavior, coherent cores, restrained local emission, floor, and lighting only; do not transfer any one family member’s anatomy or duty.
3. assets/enemies/review/pack-2/monster-grade-escalation-v1.png — Pack 2 realistic dark-fantasy finish and neutral presentation only; do not transfer Grade 7 or 10 scale, anatomy, weapons, glow, or the Tower Archmage.

Constraints:
- No labels, text, UI, frame, logo, or watermark.
- No extra creature, cropped extremity, blank band, unfinished region, or abrupt canvas cutoff.
- No resemblance to a published character or reference person.
